featured_reviews.name: saurabh sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good place to buy groceries in Mulund West.
They have two floors, ground floor has all food stuff and 1st floor has crockery, cutlery, storage boxes, bottle, bathroom stuff and some plastic and steel items.

Payment: They  accept cash and cards but are hesitant to take payment through UPI.
They can provide carry bag at extra cost of 12 to 18 rupees.

Pricing: Pricing is generally below the MRP. You can easily get 5-10% discount on MRP.

Quality: Quality of items is good.

Buying: You can move in the store, see all items, and put in you basket or trolley to checkout.

Billing: They provide electronic bill.

featured_reviews.review_text: There are a variety of groceries and other basic things available here. The staff is friendly. Also, there is a hotel right outside-they own it. They have the tastiest dosas and pav bhaji. The food is very very tasty at an affordable price.

featured_reviews.name: Astra Arya
featured_reviews.review_text: Vanakkam Southies. Come this way! What they have in stock will bring delight to you. Along with Indian products, high-quality products from Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Korea, and the UK can be found here. The Tamil people who manage this supermarket maintain quality pretty well. If you want to grab some fresh greens, veggies, or fruits, visit this store in the morning, as the stock will be empty by evening.

featured_reviews.review_text: Staff opens the products like shampoo, body wash and smells it, sprays perfumes on themselves. One staff was opening all expensive imported shampoos and bodywash and giving to a baby of a customer just for boredom and putting it back.

featured_reviews.review_text: Fresh flowers,vegetables, and every grocery item under the sun. They're especially well stocked on south indian and gujarati items. One stop shop for all home needs.

featured_reviews.name: Lalit Chhaya
featured_reviews.review_text: We are frequenter to the supermarket. They have good variety for shopping in person at market. However the delivery experience is awful. They should give expected delivery time at the time of placing order. Today placed the order at 6.16 and got the delivery at 8.35.On WhatsApp they said at 6.53 that person has left and when asked delivery boy he said he left at 8.05. Not knowing the background of complaint on WhatsApp, I believe he was truthful.

featured_reviews.name: jenny dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: I had tried Ratna Super market, the foodstuffs are good however little bit on expensive side.,but worth it...I wanted to hight light how amazing is the breakfast that you get at Ratna, If anyone has liked Mani restaurant at mulund ,you would enjoy Ratna much more Pineapple sheera is a cherry on top., Unbeatable sambar., Their string hoppers and kadla curry is fantabulous.,and Yesterday I just happened to taste their lunch, It was a  perfect sadhya thali...on a banana leaf.... exceptionally bang on unlimited service ...3 kinds of vegetables,pickel, papad, garama garm rotis, chaas, kheer,Rice rasam,sambar and dal....it was a superb deal at 200....my friends and family enjoyed a lot...I surely would recommend anyone to try out Ratna's breakfast and lunch ...It's 10 on 10

featured_reviews.name: Jerusha
featured_reviews.review_text: It’s a hidden gem for those looking for South Indian masalas, snacks and absolutely everything a South Indian, mostly Tamil, household needs. Apart from that, there are other regular super market groceries too. The space is slightly crammed but the product variety is vast. Also, there’s no air conditioning, which is a drawback in summers. I rated one star less because they don’t have an automated billing process and they don’t accept UPI bill payments; only cash and card payments are allowed.

featured_reviews.name: Sridhar Krishnamoorthy
featured_reviews.review_text: This shop is located near Mulund Railway station on Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru Road.  Lot of items related to South Indian people are available viz.,  Appalam, vadam, pickle, grocery item, and other pooja related items  at spacious place. There is a separate place for Ramraj cotton dhotis and shirts.  All together good shop.

featured_reviews.name: geekiyer
featured_reviews.review_text: Located at 215, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Rd, Mulund West, Mumbai, Aadhiganesh Stores is a compact yet well-stocked shop specializing in South Indian products. It’s a great spot for picking up items like dasangam (incense) and ingredients for traditional dishes such as Sakkara Pongal (Sweet Pongal). The owner, affectionately called "Anna," is known for being polite and frequently adding new varieties to the inventory, which keeps things fresh for regular customers. Open daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, it’s conveniently accessible. While the space is small, the curated selection and friendly service make it a reliable choice for cultural and festive shopping needs in the area.

featured_reviews.name: Varun Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text: I am a frequent visitor to this store & I must say Aadhiganesh stores never disappoints me. More you go and shop, more you feel like buying good South Indian stuffs. It's been years since I go to this store, Anna is very polite and always talks in better manner. He always brings new variety in his store. Do visit and plenty of options that you have been waiting for..

featured_reviews.name: Raj M
featured_reviews.review_text: This is an old school grocery store that stocks some otherwise difficult to find South Indian specialties. It's not a place one goes to out of choice. Staff mostly is efficient and owners have recently even started accepting UPI payments!! But they're an anachronism, insisting on selling everything at MRP (Vs discounted online grocery). Non branded things they're free to over price, given lack of competition.

featured_reviews.name: anandhi krishnan
featured_reviews.review_text:
It has been one of the oldest stores in Mulund stocking all kinds of South Indian stuff.  Right from idli rice to rice powder, pappadams, pickles, Kerala bananas, sambhar powder, rice dal powders, banana,jackfruit chips etc.

All Pooja related items like betel leaves, coconuts, haldi kumkum, items. Farsans, murukku, chakli,  seasonal items like jackfruit varati, halwas etc. Even yearly religious calendars are available here.

Festival/occasion related all items are made available for the benefit of customers.

featured_reviews.name: Rashmi Sambhat
featured_reviews.review_text: Quite a good place to buy all South Indian stuffs ranging from pooja items to basic household consumables. One stop shop for all the yummy snacks of the South!! The only drawback is that they don't provide any discounts, have to purchase everything at the mrp.

featured_reviews.name: Kris M
featured_reviews.review_text: It is one of the leading, if not the leading, general & provisions store of Mulund West, selling most of the items needed by a typical South Indian family. One can get south Indian snacks incl items imported from southern states. The store is reasonably big but given the number of items sold & displayed, there is space constraint. 4-5 decade back one had to go to Matunga E to fetch many of the south Indian goods, but with such a relatively large SI store in Mulund West, there is no need to go all the way to Matunga East. Only con I found was lack of a discount on goods at this store. All goods are sold at MRP. But I must accept this shop employs good no of employees & sales assistants &  help. So their overheads must too be quite sizeable.
